cases={
'snapshot-value':b'<?php $x=1;$s=$GLOBALS;$x=2;echo $s["x"],$x;',
'snapshot-explicit-reference':b'<?php $x=1;$r=&$x;$s=$GLOBALS;$x=2;echo $s["x"],$s["r"];',
'snapshot-reference-rebind':b'<?php $x=1;$r=&$x;$s=$GLOBALS;unset($x);$x=3;echo $s["x"],$s["r"],$x;',
'snapshot-array-cow':b'<?php $x=[1];$s=$GLOBALS;$s["x"][0]=2;echo $x[0],$s["x"][0];',
'snapshot-embedded-reference':b'<?php $v=1;$x=[&$v];$s=$GLOBALS;$s["x"][0]=2;echo $v,$x[0];',
'snapshot-lhs-undefined-omitted':b'<?php $s=$GLOBALS;echo $s["s"]??"missing";',
'snapshot-dead-cv-omitted':b'<?php if(false){$missing=1;}$s=$GLOBALS;foreach($s as $k=>$v){if($k==="missing"){echo "bad";}}echo "ok";',
'snapshot-reference-initializes-null':b'<?php $r=&$missing;$s=$GLOBALS;echo $s["missing"]===null,$s["r"]===null;',
'snapshot-numeric-keys':b'<?php ${"12"}=1;${"012"}=2;${"-1"}=3;$s=$GLOBALS;foreach($s as $k=>$v){if($k===12){echo "I",$v;}if($k==="012"){echo "S",$v;}if($k===-1){echo "N",$v;}}',
'snapshot-dead-cv-order':b'<?php if(false){$x=0;}$y=2;$x=1;$s=$GLOBALS;foreach($s as $k=>$v){if($k==="x"||$k==="y"){echo $k,$v;}}',
'snapshot-unset-reinsert-order':b'<?php $x=1;$y=2;unset($x);$x=3;$s=$GLOBALS;foreach($s as $k=>$v){if($k==="x"||$k==="y"){echo $k,$v;}}',
'snapshot-dynamic-insertion-order':b'<?php $n="x";$$n=1;$y=2;$s=$GLOBALS;foreach($s as $k=>$v){if($k==="x"||$k==="y"){echo $k,$v;}}',
'snapshot-later-global-insert':b'<?php $s=$GLOBALS;$GLOBALS["z"]=9;echo $s["z"]??0;',
'snapshot-dynamic-globals-name':b'<?php $x=1;$n="GLOBALS";$s=$$n;$x=2;echo $s["x"],$x;',
'globals-foreach-value-snapshot':b'<?php $x=1;$y=2;foreach($GLOBALS as $k=>$v){if($k==="x"){echo $v;$y=9;}if($k==="y"){echo $v;}}',
'globals-whole-reference-rejection':b'<?php echo "before";$s=&$GLOBALS;echo "after";',
}
